name: Fabric Racing Game - Data Pipeline Edition
description: 🏎️ Race through 10 Fabric-themed tracks! Collect ⭐ data points, avoid 🐛 bugs, reach the finish line with enough points to advance. Features consecutive multipliers up to x10!
learning_objectives: Configure JSON mapping for KQL ingestion
Integrate HTML5 games in Fabric Notebooks
Analyze player performance with time-series queries

story.intro: Welcome to the Fabric Racing Championship! Race through 10 unique tracks, collect stars for points, and avoid obstacles. Build the RTI infrastructure that powers the competition!

chapters.title: Qualifying
chapters.description: Setup KQL Database with GameEvents table

chapters.title: Championship
chapters.description: Complete all 10 tracks and climb the leaderboard

chapters.title: Victory Lap
chapters.description: Analyze your performance with KQL dashboards

post_deploy_steps: Open RacingStream Eventstream and add a Custom Endpoint source (TelemetryInput)
Add an Eventhouse destination in 'Event processing before ingestion' mode (RacingEventhouse → RaceData → create new table GameEvents, Json)
Copy the 4 SAS values from the Custom Endpoint into Racing_Championship Cell 1
Run the notebook and start racing!
